title: ee.index.backfill_anchors.v1
description: Bounded, workspace-scoped preview or application of code-anchor backfill from eligible existing memory content. Preview is the default; --apply explicitly opts into additive attachment. Carried under ee.response.v2 data.

skippedMemories.description: Present when memories are skipped by the per-memory candidate safety limit. Each memory is skipped in full before planning or attachment; other memories and pagination continue normally. These entries are included in skippedMemoryCount and are not proposals.

nextAfter.description: Pass this memory ID to --after to scan the next bounded page; null means the scan is complete. Continue even when the current page proposes no anchors.

proposals.description: Redaction-safe per-memory attachment reports. Each anchor retains its hash and may include a screened normalized locator for reviewing the proposed relationship. No raw memory content or source provenance is returned.
